source_boundary_repairs.method: split at exact segment intersection; preserve largest boundary; retain tiny loop as non-occupiable region

wall_inference.method: room boundary bands; internal width follows polygon gaps; original wall centerlines absent

limitations: Archisketch coordinates are not independent as-built measurements.
112A ceiling 2.6m retains the selected height; catalog opening heights and frame allowances are provisional.
Basic and expanded source widths differ; no global rescaling.
Source polygons differ from the older dimensioned 112A image. Sources are preserved without averaging.
No fixtures/furniture. Narrow balcony strips retain geometry but are not walking start options.
